Hi,

Thanks for asking about both.

On the Harlo Pool free spins, I don't want to guess how they're credited or linked to your purchase. I've asked the team to confirm exactly how it works. They pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer will come to this email.

The bundle is still listed as the Harlo Duo Pack. It's one Harlo B30 and one H15 Dual for $1,599, compared with $1,698 bought separately. It's sold out right now and there's no restock date yet, so I've asked the team about that too. The product page has a "Notify me" button that will email you if it comes back in stock.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thank you for the quick reply!  I’m also wondering about what Firmware options there are for the H15 and B30.  It’s strange to me that there’s no Harlo firmware for them, can you elaborate?  Is a Harlo firmware coming soon?

Hi,

Glad the first reply helped.

On firmware, both the B30 and the H15 Dual run their manufacturer's stock firmware. That's what we support on both.

The team stopped building Harlo OS for now. They're working on an alternative and will share news when it's ready, but there's no date or name for it yet. So I wouldn't base your decision on a new Harlo firmware arriving soon.

Your questions about the free spins and the bundle are still with the team. That answer will come to this email.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
